codeReview.summary: Cloudflare crawl now surfaces structured pageFailures for non-completed records and learn-web carries them through to the final result. The regression test covers mixed completed/skipped/disallowed/cancelled records end-to-end, and I found no blocking issues in the fix.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The learn-worker procedure still appears too rigid for crawl/provider fixes that change shared result shapes first and then need regression coverage. This fix again required implementation-first exploration before the final mixed-status assertions were obvious.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: handoff.skillFeedback.followedProcedure=false; the handoff says the worker wired provider/result plumbing before extending the Cloudflare regression, then verified the contract with targeted and full test runs.

summary: Reviewed the Cloudflare page-failure fix against the prior learn-web-hardening failure and confirmed it resolves the blocking gap for non-completed crawl records.
